summary: Enhance your skills with our Social Performance Management Training. Learn effective strategies to boost team performance and drive organizational success.
lede: Social performance management is the structured measurement of social outcomes, stakeholder feedback, and how evidence informs program decisions. For professionals responsible for social outcomes and reporting, this course covers building a Theory of Change and indicator matrix, designing feedback collection, analyzing findings, and using them to plan improvements and report results.
audienceIntro: This course is for professionals who manage social outcomes, reporting, and stakeholder evidence in organizations that need credible social performance management.
audience: Executive Assistants to ESG or Impact teams
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, spreadsheet software, and access to sample program or stakeholder data where available. If your organization uses KoboToolbox, Microsoft Forms, Power BI, or similar reporting tools, you can apply them during the exercises, but the course remains usable with standard office software.
